decision_rationale: The sectioned text describes GROVER as a foundation DLM, but the model is built on the transformer encoder BERT and framed around next-k-mer prediction and fine-tuning, not explicit generation. That supports foundation-model-like pretraining, but not a genuinely generative architecture.
evidence_snippet: "GROVER adapts the transformer encoder BERT architecture"; "selected using nextk-mer prediction"; "We have built GROVER, a foundation DLM"; "outperforms similar models" for fine-tuning tasks;
